note: Four loops on the south shore of Clear Lake: Kelsey Creek (sites 27-91) on the spit between the lake and Kelsey Slough, Cole Creek along the creek, and Lower and Upper Bayview on the hill above Dorn Cove. Only Kelsey Creek has lakeside sites; premium sites 58-60 at its east end sit at the shore by the swim area. --Claude
summary: parks.ca.gov, camp map and ReserveCalifornia read. Rate $30 -> $35 (every site, every date sampled, premium included). 147 sites, no hookups, dump, pay showers, flush toilets. Kelsey Creek year-round, other loops open 2027-05-07. Pad lengths: Kelsey 32-35, Cole 20-28, Bayview 15-21 (page says 35 everywhere). No closure banner. Lakefront KEPT at Kelsey Creek premium 58-60.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront KEPT (not --AWH): Kelsey Creek's lakeside premium sites 58, 59 and 60 (campground map 'Lakeside Premium Campsite'; ReserveCalifornia 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront'; pad length 35 ft, so a 23-ft rig can book them, $35) sit at the east end of the spit, ~39.01866,-122.80700. Esri z19 shows pads on open sand with a few trees, water 13-18 m north. 3DEP puts the pads at 405.6 m and lidar water at 403.9-404.4 m (~1.3-1.7 m up), so the kayak test passes. Clear Lake is a natural lake, so there is no reservoir drawdown issue. Most other Kelsey Creek lake-side spurs (77-88) sit 45-60 m back behind a continuous tree belt. Replacement evidence: 'Esri z19 + 3DEP 2026-11-27: Kelsey Creek premium 58-60 (map Lakeside Premium; RC Lakefront; 35 ft) at ~39.01866,-122.80700, pads 405.6 m, open sand 13-18 m to lidar water 403.9-404.4 m; other lake-side spurs 45-60 m back behind trees.'

SITE LENGTH CONFLICT (no drop): the park page says 'All of our sites can fit a maximum camper/trailer length of 35 feet', but ReserveCalifornia pad lengths are 15-21 ft in both Bayview loops and 20-28 ft in Cole Creek. Kelsey Creek's 57 web units (32-35 ft) clear 23 ft easily. RC's grid VehicleLength is a uniform 30 (placeholder).
